Hi all —

Investigation summary: our outbound invite service includes no explicit locale param; Workday's global edge can inject locale via Accept-Language and then issue a geo-redirect. The redirect added a host rewrite to workday.co.uk which caused the invite token to be validated against the wrong tenant (hence "Account not found").

Immediate remediation we applied:
1) Issued a one-time manual activation code and attached it below (activation-manual-code.txt) — Samantha, use this code at the "Have an activation code?" flow on the Workday onboarding page.
2) Re-issued the invite with an explicit query param locale=en-US and a signed token to avoid edge rewriting.
3) Opened a support ticket with Workday (WD-881234) and attached the redirect headers for their engineering team to fix long-term.

Next steps for the Redwood platform: we should update the invite generator to include locale=en-US for invites to US-based vendors, and include X-Prefer-Region header to reduce edge host rewrites. I'll raise a quick PR to add the param and a unit test.

Samantha — your manual activation code (one-time use): CODE-7FQ4-19X
Attachment: activation-manual-code.txt (text/plain)

Let me know if you get in successfully and I'll mark the onboarding checklist complete from our side.

Best,
